interpretation.observed_queue_speed: FD-inferred from episode mean flow D/P; not directly measured
interpretation.recovery_discharge: mu_obs_vphpl is a separate recovery-window diagnostic, not the queue-state discharge
interpretation.metadata_capacity: PeMS network total divided by metadata lane count; unavailable for supplied Arizona files
interpretation.undefined_queue_speed_APE: Suppressed when either state falls outside the strict congested FD domain; raw algebraic difference remains in vq_algebraic_ape_pct
interpretation.inverse_analysis: Provided separately in inverse_queue_speed_verification.json and fd_sensitivity_verification.json; the traffic audit above verifies only the source parameter join.
